facts.fact: The Data Protection Commission, led by its Executive Director, is acting under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).
The article describes the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) as the existing legislation, with registration duty under Section 27(1) and penalties under Section 56.
The Data Protection Commission reports that in 2025 it expanded registrations of data controllers, conducted compliance audits across key sectors and trained more than 800 data protection officers.
